questions.question: Define sub soil (subsurface) irrigation.
questions.solution_html:
• A method of irrigation in which water is supplied below the soil surface directly to the
  • root zone through buried pipes or channels, maintaining adequate moisture without
  • wetting the surface.

questions.question: What is Integrated Pest Management?
questions.solution_html:
• An eco-friendly approach to pest control that combines biological, cultural
  • mechanical, and chemical methods in a coordinated way to manage pest populations
  • below economic damage levels while minimizing harm to the environment, human
  • health, and beneficial organisms.
